description: Dataset of flight schedules, passenger flow, indoor and outdoor environment, HVAC systems in airport is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Zhiwei Li (Hong Kong Polytechnic University). The dataset includes flight schedules, passenger security-check information (no privacy), HVAC systems, and indoor and outdoor environment in airport terminals. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 829394. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
